operation_title: This method creates a new subscription. This method shall support the URI query parameters specified in table 6.1.3.4.3.1-1.

request_body.description: The request body contains the input parameters for the subscription. These parameters include, e.g.: Target NF type; Target Service Name; Callback URI of the Requester NF.

response_body.description: This case represents the successful creation of a subscription.

notes: No query parameters are defined for this method.
This method shall support the request data structures specified in table 6.1.3.4.3.1-2 and the response data structures and response codes specified in table 6.1.3.4.3.1-3.

Upon success, the HTTP response shall include a "Location" HTTP header that contains the resource URI of the created resource. NOTE: The mandatory HTTP error status codes for the PUT method listed in Table 5.2.7.1-1 of 3GPP TS 29.500 [4] other than those specified in the table above also apply, with a ProblemDetails data type (see subclause 5.2.7 of 3GPP TS 29.500 [4]).

constraints.statement: The request body shall be present and contain exactly one SubscriptionData object.
The response for successful subscription creation shall use HTTP status code 201 Created.
On successful creation, the response shall include a Location header containing the URI of the created resource.
This operation shall not define any URI query parameters.
The request body shall include nfStatusNotificationUri with cardinality 1.
The request body shall include reqNotifEvents with cardinality 1..N.
The request body shall not include subscriptionId because it is read-only.
If reqNotifEvents is present, each item shall be one of NF_REGISTERED, NF_DEREGISTERED, or NF_PROFILE_CHANGED.
If reqNfType is present, its value shall be one of the NFType enumeration values.
If notifCondition.monitoredAttributes is present, it shall contain one or more strings.
If notifCondition.unmonitoredAttributes is present, it shall contain one or more strings.
If subscrCond is absent, the subscription request applies to all NFs in the NRF.
If reqNotifEvents is absent, notifications for all event types are requested.
If notifCondition.monitoredAttributes is present, the NRF shall send notifications only for changes in the listed attributes.
If notifCondition.unmonitoredAttributes is present, the NRF shall send notifications for changes on any attribute except those listed.
